# HRPUB

> HRPUB (Horizon Research Publishing Co. Ltd) is a peer-reviewed academic publisher specializing in journals across engineering, mathematics, and scientific research.

HRPUB operates hrpub.org as a platform for publishing and accessing peer-reviewed research articles and journal information. The site hosts multiple journals including Civil Engineering and Architecture, with rigorous submission guidelines and editorial standards.

## Key Topics

- Horizon Research Publishing Co. Ltd
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Civil Engineering and Architecture
- Mathematics and Statistics
- ISSN 2332-1091
- ISSN 2332-1121
- Submission guidelines
- Editorial board
- Publication ethics

## Journals

- [Civil Engineering and Architecture](https://www.hrpub.org/journals/jour_info.php?id=48): Journal information, submission guidelines, editorial board, and publication ethics for HRPUB's Civil Engineering and Architecture journal (ISSN 2332-1091, 2332-1121)

## Research Articles

- [Normal Distribution Approximation Formula](https://www.hrpub.org/journals/article_info.php?aid=1470): Research article by Amit Choudhury (Gauhati University) on normal distribution approximation formula and cumulative distribution function methods
